# Wald Inference Core

Repository: https://github.com/reblocke/wald-inference-core
Distribution: wald-inference
Import: wald_inference
License: MIT
Maintainer: Brian Locke (@reblocke)

Purpose:
Pure-Python numerical utilities for documented one-parameter normal/Wald reconstruction,
compatibility, normalized relative support, exact detectability, selected-claim, Type S/M, and
precision calculations.
The public relative-support APIs include log-domain pairwise comparisons and support intervals for
finite MLE-to-bound ratios greater than one; S−2 is the special case R = exp(2).
The public detectability APIs evaluate all six canonical selection rules forward and invert only the
two-sided and matching one-sided p-value rules. The fixed z-sum marker remains a separate legacy
closed-form benchmark.
The public joint-precision API solves each mandatory guardrail through the preserved per-target
solver, reports the strictest finite SE and binding target(s), and propagates any infeasible target
without discarding rows. The sensitivity API maps this result deterministically across explicitly
assumed working-scale true effects.

Start with:
- README.md
- docs/SCIENTIFIC_SCOPE.md
- docs/API.md
- docs/VALIDATION.md
- docs/MIGRATION_PROVENANCE.md

Important constraints:
- This package does not recover exact fitted-model likelihood.
- Pairwise support ordering is L(A)/L(B); retain the log result when exponentiation overflows.
- Exact critical effects are repeated-study Wald detectability thresholds, not observed evidence,
  confidence bounds, validated meaningful effects, or study-specific sample-size results.
- Finite support-interval endpoints are independently verified against their requested log-support
  boundary and fail with ValidationError when binary64 quantization is materially inaccurate.
- Type S/M quantities are repeated-study operating characteristics, not posterior probabilities.
- Joint precision is feasible only when all requested mandatory guardrails are feasible; current
  sufficiency has multiplier exactly 1.0.
- Relative information is not automatically sample size and sensitivity inputs are not a
  probability distribution over the true effect.
- Ratio measures are evaluated on the log working scale.
- Serializable calculation outputs use finite numbers or None; selection-rule intervals use
  infinities only as mathematical open-tail sentinels.
- Browser contracts, UI rendering, exports, telemetry, and persistence are out of scope.
- Numerical behavior is tied to the tagged pre-split baseline and its committed parity corpus.
- Public issues, pull requests, fixtures, screenshots, and logs use synthetic values only and must
  not contain PHI, patient-level data, credentials, or restricted data.
- Vulnerabilities use GitHub private vulnerability reporting as documented in `SECURITY.md`.
- Future releases require an exact remote-bound annotated tag, full-SHA Action pins,
  build-provenance attestations, exact draft-asset re-download verification, and proof of immutable
  stable publication.
- GitHub Releases are the sole authorized distribution channel; PyPI publishing is prohibited.
